snippet.title: Bel's Fanfare — Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Bel's Fanfare is an immersive RPG with exploration and expressive bullet hell encounters. You play as Bel, the new aura cleaner of the once-luxurious vessel The Witch of the Sea.

Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/chibig/bels-fanfare
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4317460/Bels_Fanfare/
